Kestrel._about: HTTPS uses the 'localhost' certificate from the current user's certificate store (the ASP.NET Core development certificate: 'dotnet dev-certs https --trust'). To use another certificate, replace the Https endpoint's Certificate with { "Path": "C:/path/to/cert.pfx", "Password": "..." }. The Http endpoint only redirects to HTTPS.

App._about: Relative folders are resolved against the folder holding the server's binaries (the 'server' folder of a deployment), so by default both data folders sit next to 'client' and 'server'.

Smtp._about: Leave Host empty to write outgoing e-mails as text files into <LocalDataFolder>/outbox instead of sending them (useful until SMTP is configured). For Gmail: smtp.gmail.com, 587, EnableSsl true, User = the address, Password = an app password.
